programme: 2027 JET Programme Assistant Language Teacher, India application route
evidenceLimit: Official pages were read through web research. Local HTTPS requests for robots.txt, page and PDF returned Access Denied. No exact bytes are retained, so this is not a staged cycle or publishable listing.

findings.value: Assistant Language Teacher in Japanese schools or local boards of education; public or private placement may follow selection
findings.evidence: Embassy page, Assistant Language Teacher and Duties sections; 2027 guidelines pp. 1–2

findings.value: India route requires Indian passport; nationality of recruitment country is required in general guidelines. Other citizens should use own embassy routes.
findings.evidence: Embassy page, Eligibility Requirements; 2027 guidelines p. 5, condition 5
findings.qualificationNote: Embassy document checklist permits alternate nationality proof when passport is not yet held at application, so founder must check timing of passport requirement.

findings.value: Excellent English pronunciation and language ability required. Japanese language background earns additional consideration; no mandatory JLPT level or certificate for ALT.
findings.evidence: Embassy page, Eligibility Requirements and Additional Points; 2027 guidelines pp. 5–6

findings.value: Embassy application page says email application and audio file no later than Friday 30 October 2026; linked generic guidelines p. 6 say submit by [31 October 2026]. Do not silently choose later date.
findings.evidence: Embassy page, Recruitment Timeline and Steps 4–5; 2027 guidelines p. 6, Application Procedures
findings.action: Seek embassy clarification; conservatively tell applicants to follow the 30 October country-specific page while conflict is unresolved.

coverageLimit: Only India ALT route researched. CIR, other national routes and later amendments need separate evidence and dates.
